summary: E2E test of the new Partner Positions 5-tier referral system. 23/23 pytest tests PASSED + 1 xfail documenting a real notification-persistence bug. Frontend AdminPartners page renders correctly, PIN + assign flow verified with live toast 'SANTOSH AVHALE → National Partner'. Two backend bugs found (see rca).

test_results.backend_commission_national_partner_7_ho: PASS (u8 at hop 7 credited 1.0 PRC from 100 PRC collect, ledger row correct: type=mining_referral_reward, tier_percent=1.0, downline_name populated)
test_results.backend_commission_district_partner_dept: PASS (u6 at hop 5 not credited when levels=4)
test_results.backend_commission_elite_gate_blocks_non: PASS (u4 with state_partner + explorer plan gets 0 commission; ledger empty)
test_results.backend_commission_idempotency_same_time: PASS (2 calls → 1 ledger row per recipient)
test_results.frontend_assign_position_e2e_flow: PASS (PIN + query + select + submit → toast 'SANTOSH AVHALE → National Partner')
test_results.frontend_load_partners_after_assign: PARTIAL — assign toast was success but the auto-refreshed list did not immediately show the newly-assigned row in the test session (see minor issue)

minor.issue: Notification insert silently fails with E11000 duplicate key on notification_id=null. First assignment succeeds only IF no prior row with notification_id=null exists in db.notifications. Result: users never receive the in-app 'promoted to X' notification (swallowed by try/except in partner_positions.py:132-147).

commission_active uses strict `subscription_plan == 'elite'` check (line 267) but mining_commission.py uses ELITE_PLANS = {elite,vip,startup,growth,pro} PLUS membership_type field. Users with membership_type='vip' or 'elite'/'startup'/'growth'/'pro' plan will see 'Upgrade to Elite' banner even though they DO receive commission. Example: test user 9970100782 with membership_type='vip' — badge tells him to upgrade despite being fully eligible.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful assign(), fetchPartners() is invoked but in one test run the auto-refreshed 'Current Partners' list did not include the newly-assigned partner row (data-testid partner-row-{uid} not present). Manual refresh via 'Load Partners' button may still show 0 rows in some cases. Possible race with fetchPartners response caching or list reset.

action_items: FIX: partner_positions.py:133 — add `notification_id: str(uuid.uuid4())` to the notification insert dict (or use routes.notifications.create_notification helper like mining_commission.py already does). This will restore the promotion notification bell.

FIX: partner_positions.py:267 — change `user.get('subscription_plan') == 'elite'` to use the same ELITE_PLANS set + membership_type check that mining_commission.py:141 uses (`_is_elite_active`), so the badge accurately reflects who will actually receive commission.

INVESTIGATE: Post-assign list refresh in AdminPartners.js — verify pin state isn't being cleared/reset when the axios request settles; consider making the assign response push the new partner into `partners` state directly instead of relying on a follow-up GET.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_positions.py is only 274 lines — well within guidelines. Good.
POSITION_CONFIG is defined in Python and duplicated as POSITION_OPTIONS in AdminPartners.js. Consider exposing POSITION_CONFIG via a GET endpoint so the two never drift.

mining_commission.py has partner_position overlay logic mixed with legacy tier logic in a single 165-line while loop; readable but consider extracting `_calculate_tier_for_upline(upline, hop, legacy_tiers)` for testability.

admin_assign_position endpoint uses `email regex` for lookup with user input directly interpolated in `$regex`. If the query contains regex metacharacters (e.g. '.*'), it could match unintended users. Recommend `re.escape(q)` before interpolation.

distribute_mining_collect_commission's max_walk = max(max_tiers, 7) hardcodes 7 to match NATIONAL_PARTNER levels. Better: `max_walk = max(max_tiers, max(cfg['levels'] for cfg in POSITION_CONFIG.values()))` to auto-adjust if a new deeper tier is added.

AdminPartners.js has NO auth-gate on component mount — relies entirely on route-level canAccessAdmin. The X-Admin-Pin is entered client-side (fine) but the JWT Bearer token from localStorage is what actually gates /api/admin/* via server middleware. Good defence-in-depth.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (page loads + assign flow + toast verified; list-refresh race observed once)

seed_data_creation: Created 8 TEST_pp_u1..TEST_pp_u8 users forming an 8-deep referral chain for commission distribution testing. All auto-cleaned in fixture teardown (users + prc_ledger + notifications). No production data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To rerun: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_partner_positions_e2e.py -v`. All tests seed and teardown their own data. If notification bug is fixed, remove the pytest.xfail marker in TestNotificationBug and the assertion will become a hard PASS. If commission_active elite-gate is fixed to use ELITE_PLANS set, update test_position_reflects_in_my_position to also verify commission_active=True for membership_type='vip' users.
rca_of_the_issue: TWO BACKEND BUGS FOUND: (1) NOTIFICATION DUP-KEY: partner_positions.py inserts partner_position_assigned notifications without a `notification_id` field, but db.notifications has a UNIQUE INDEX on notification_id → first insert stores null, all subsequent inserts crash with E11000. The try/except swallows the failure, so callers see success. Repro: assign a position to any user twice, tail backend logs for '[PARTNERS] notification insert failed' → E11000 duplicate key error. Fix: add `"notification_id": str(uuid.uuid4())` on line 134 of partner_positions.py, or route through routes.notifications.create_notification helper which already handles this. (2) ELITE-GATE MISMATCH: partner_positions.py:267 checks `user.get('subscription_plan') == 'elite'` for commission_active in the UI badge, but mining_commission.py:141 (`_is_elite_active`) accepts any of ELITE_PLANS={elite,vip,startup,growth,pro} AND checks membership_type too. Repro: for user 9970100782 (membership_type=vip, subscription_plan=explorer originally) → my-position returns commission_active=false, prompting 'Upgrade to Elite', but distribute_mining_collect_commission WILL credit them because they pass _is_elite_active. Fix: replace line 267 with `commission_active: _is_elite_active(user)` and import the helper from mining_commission, OR duplicate the same ELITE_PLANS + membership_type check inline.
